title: Watch: Tracing the deadly path of the Nepal-Tibet flash flood
summary_cn: 尼泊尔-西藏边境地区遭遇洪水灾害，摧毁城镇并冲毁桥梁，已报告数百人死亡，另有数百人失踪。BBC Verify通过核实视频和卫星图像追踪了致命山洪的路径。
paragraphs_en: This video can not be played
Floods have devastated the Nepal-Tibet border region which have destroyed towns and swept away bridges.
Hundreds of people have been reported dead and hundreds more missing.
BBC Verify has traced the path of the deadly flash flood using verified videos and satellite imagery. Merlyn Thomas reports.
Produced by Aisha Sembhi. Graphics by Mesut Ersoz. Verification by Emma Pengelly, Paul Brown, Charlotte Green, Shayan Sardarizadeh, Yi Ma and Benedict Garman.
paragraphs_cn: 洪水摧毁了尼泊尔-西藏边境地区，摧毁了城镇，冲毁了桥梁。
据报道，已有数百人死亡，另有数百人失踪。
BBC Verify使用经过验证的视频和卫星图像追踪了这场致命山洪的路径。梅林·托马斯报道。
由艾莎·森比制作。图形由梅苏特·埃尔索兹设计。验证由艾玛·彭格利、保罗·布朗、夏洛特·格林、沙扬·萨达尔扎德、马毅和本尼迪克特·加曼完成。
